wire_motion_clearance.scope: Fixed nominal cable path envelope; individual guide rotations about nominal pivot.

elbow_guide_sweep.scope: Shoulder neutral; forearm rigid movement; distal swivel angles held neutral.

elbow_to_shoulder_rigid_sweep.scope: Rigid cross-module pairs only. Shared humerus and TPU are separate checks.

wire_to_moving_elbow_sweep.scope: Nominal cable from anchor to anchor. Distal swivels held neutral. Shared GH transform cancels in these relative poses.

coupled_rigid_sweep.scope: Prescribed GH 0–30 degrees with elbow 0–120 degrees. Forearm solids and nominal elbow wires versus identified stationary shoulder solids. Flexor uses interpolated route, extensor uses fixed guide.

assembly_readback.scope: Includes both revised lattices, caps, adapters and both nominal bone-seat fastener sets. Dedicated guide retention unverified.

scope: Neutral local guide mounting screen against extensor TPU, elbow adapters and local wire fan. Other solids and assembly path pending.
